description: Fetch conversation history for a Pickaxe agent. Use to analyze user questions, identify KB gaps, and review agent performance.

format.description: Output format. 'messages' is human-readable, 'raw' includes metadata. Default: messages

limit.description: Maximum conversations to return. Default: 10, Max: 100

pickaxeId.description: The Pickaxe agent ID (from the agent URL or config)

skip.description: Number of conversations to skip (for pagination). Default: 0

studio.description: Studio name to use. Available: ID. Default: ID

name: chat_history
